entities.name: Michiko
entities.description: Princess who left Eiganjo and got lost in Jukai.

entities.description: Kitsune tracker who tried to pull Nagao to safety.

entities.description: Saved the group from the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos and ferried them to the kitsune village.

events.summary: Nagao arrives at Sugi Hayashi and demands the princess's immediate return.
events.quote: Nagao arrived at the kitsune village Sugi Hayashi and demanded the princess' immediate return.

events.summary: Nagao is wounded by Shujiro Yamazaki's bolt while fighting the akki horde.
events.quote: During the fight, Nagao was wounded by Shujiro Yamazaki 's bolt in the chest.

events.summary: Sharp-Ear tries to rescue Nagao but must leave him; Nagao is later found and recovers.
events.quote: However, Nagao was miraculously found, brought back, and slowly recovered

events.summary: Nagao and his men escort Michiko to Minamo with Silver-Foot's kitsune.
Toshi Umezawa and Kiku save them from the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
